title: The faithful diagonal circle is not an automorphic relabeling of the original circle

comparison.original_kernel: The K1356 one-factor circle C has full-carrier kernel {1,z} of order two.
comparison.diagonal_kernel: The diagonal circle D has trivial full-carrier kernel.
comparison.automorphism_invariant: Precomposition by either U(1) automorphism beta maps to plus_or_minus beta preserves the kernel order.
comparison.inequivalence: No original-circle automorphism converts the C action into the D action; D is a genuinely different embedded circle.
comparison.norms: For orthogonal unit one-factor bivectors, ||T_C||^2=1 and ||T_D||^2=1/2.
comparison.normalization_fence: The bare norm ratio does not supply a physical gauge coupling; source action ownership must choose the circle, kinetic coefficient and normalization together.

claim_ceiling: C and D are inequivalent as circle actions because their kernels differ; their primitive generators also have a one-half compact norm-squared ratio in the declared control convention. No physical coupling or hypercharge identification follows.
